events.event: President Prabowo, after attending Muhammadiyah's Tanwir in Palu, arrived in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit (15-17 Nov) and is to continue to the APEC summit in China, and he will name his two vice-presidential candidates only after the trips.
events.key_numbers: ASEAN Summit 15-17 Nov 2026 (Manila) · APEC summit in China next, date not confirmed · MPR plenary 2 Dec 2026
events.why_it_matters: The President is abroad this week, which sets how fast the new vice president can be named.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA, detik, CNN Indonesia, Liputan6 all covered his arrival 14 Nov

events.event: Wed 18 Nov is the latest date for President Prabowo to hand MPR leadership two vice-presidential candidate names, since the MPR rules require submission at least 14 days before the 2 Dec plenary; MPR chair Muzani said 'insyaallah' the names arrive next week.
events.key_numbers: Deadline about 18 Nov 2026 · 2 names · at least 14 days before the plenary (Peraturan MPR 1/2024, Art. 136(1) per Okezone) · plenary Wed 2 Dec 2026 · Prabowo told parties to discuss proposals within about 1 week
events.why_it_matters: The week's biggest political date: who becomes the next vice president is decided by two names due this week.
events.spreading_evidence: ANTARA terpopuler 14 Nov: MPR discussing VP filling

events.event: Parties floated names for the vacant vice presidency: PAN's Zulkifli Hasan proposed a Gerindra cadre, Golkar said Puan and Bahlil are in the running while it awaits its own deliberation, and DPD figures raised Sultan Najamuddin and Sri Sultan HB X; the Palace has named no one.
events.key_numbers: 2 candidates to be proposed · Golkar names: Puan Maharani, Bahlil Lahadalia · DPD alternatives: Sultan Najamuddin, Sultan HB X · Demokrat (AHY) said earlier it will not submit a name
events.why_it_matters: Shows who may be Indonesia's next number two, with the shortlist still open.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia and detik section pages lead with VP candidate items 13-14 Nov

events.event: Paspampres said Gibran keeps protective escort after leaving office, with the detail shifting to Grup D, and photos of him began to be taken down in government buildings.
events.key_numbers: Escort moved to Paspampres Grup D · resignation effective 12 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: Small signs of how the transition from a sitting vice president to former status is handled.

events.event: The Jakarta Tipikor court rejected ex-Deputy Minister Silmy Karim's objection (putusan sela) on 12 Nov, so his gratification and extortion trial over residence permits for foreigners continues with prosecution witnesses on Tue 17 Nov.
events.key_numbers: Putusan sela 12 Nov 2026 · next hearing Tue 17 Nov 2026 (witnesses) · case 81/Pid.Sus-TPK/2026/PN Jkt.Pst · charges: gratifikasi and pemerasan on izin tinggal terbatas
events.why_it_matters: A former minister-level official's trial moves into the evidence stage this week.

events.event: DPR Komisi III formed a working committee (Panja) chaired by Habiburokhman to finish the Asset Forfeiture Bill (RUU Perampasan Aset), targeting passage by 15 Dec 2026 and holding public hearings during recess.
events.key_numbers: Target passage by 15 Dec 2026 · 35 RDPU and 3 regional visits (DPR) · DPR Masa Persidangan II runs 10 Nov to 17 Dec 2026
events.why_it_matters: A law letting the state seize assets from corruption proceeds, long stalled, now has a passage date.

events.event: Komnas HAM asked UGM for CCTV footage of the 10 Nov demonstration, while a Surabaya citizens' coalition criticised alleged violence by officers against protesters in Yogyakarta.
events.why_it_matters: A possible rights-abuse inquiry into how police handled a student protest.

events.event: Police said the alleged rape by Kupang Regent took place at the official residence, according to police statements reported by CNN Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: A sitting regional head faces a serious criminal allegation, with no court finding yet.
